headline: Subshell 1.0.2: steadier comment threads, cleaner links and new defaults
highlights: Comment threads no longer jump while replies load. The comment you are reading stays where it is, also when you scroll up from an Inbox reply.
A thread opens where you left it, also after Android has closed the app in the background.
Replies load sooner and in fewer steps, and the loading row no longer flashes on screen.
Clean links: tracking parameters (utm_, fbclid and many more) are removed when you open a link. On by default; turn it off in Settings > Media & links.
Long links are shown short, in text and on link cards.
Long press a link to share it, copy it, open it in your browser, or copy the original address.

New defaults for settings you have never changed, among them the drawer on the right, 24-hour time, NSFW posts and media shown, and high video quality on mobile data. Settings you chose yourself stay as they are.
TalkBack reads a link post's picture by its site name instead of the whole address.
If something does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
